targets.licensed_change: Narrow the thermal-trigger applicability only for the observed reflective silver-film and toward-sun off-nadir configuration evidenced by E1. M0's thermal trigger alone must not determine the block disposition in that configuration; independent water evidence or a discriminating scan/measurement is required.
targets.preserved_scope: Keep the M0 threshold and procedure for the validated ordinary mineral soil and dark organic mulch contexts where the thermal/contact measurements agreed with independent water observations.
targets.changed_scope: The source-bound reflective-surface and view-geometry combination supported by E1; do not invent a universal reflectance cutoff or extend to every reflective material or camera angle.
targets.required_uncertainty: Leave mixed-cover or unmeasured view geometry unresolved and request surface/view characterization plus independent root-zone VWC or contact measurement.
forbidden_overreaction: globally change the M0 2.0 C trigger
claim that every reflective surface invalidates thermal measurements
infer irrigation or plant stress solely from the E1 thermal readings
required_lineage: E1 source locators OBS-01 through OBS-04 and OBS-06 as applicable
new M1 boundary relation with preserved M0 scope
targets.claim_ceiling: bounded synthetic revision design; no external agronomy claim

targets.licensed_change: Represent the distinct measured mineral-dominant and organic-floc-rich turbidity-to-mass relationships as coexisting, composition-conditional branches. Preserve the M0 calibration for the source-supported mineral-dominant scope and add a bounded relation for the observed floc-rich scope using the E1 pairs.
targets.preserved_scope: Retain the M0 formula, range, and uncertainty for mineral-dominant samples with valid measurement controls.
targets.changed_scope: Add a composition-selected coexisting relationship for the observed floc-rich samples; do not claim a universal composition cutoff beyond what E1 measures.
targets.required_uncertainty: For intermediate, mixed, or aliquot-variable composition, do not average branches or force a branch; request repeat composition and gravimetric measurements or report a bounded unresolved estimate.
forbidden_overreaction: average the two relationships into one universal line
select a branch without composition evidence
assert a universal threshold for every sediment matrix
required_lineage: E1 source locators OBS-01 through OBS-08
two conditional M1 relations and their measured selection basis
targets.claim_ceiling: bounded synthetic revision design; no external water-quality claim

targets.licensed_change: Retire the interval-mean-only screen for the observed group-P short-pulse context, replacing it with a bounded review rule that uses verified high-rate trace and product identity. Evidence supports review for pulse cases in the observed E1 envelope but does not establish a universal numerical degradation threshold.
targets.preserved_scope: Keep M0's interval-mean screen for the validated continuous-profile cases, including group-P no-pulse records and unaffected formulations for which evidence supports the old behavior.
targets.changed_scope: Verified group-P high-rate traces with brief excursions in the observed pulse range, where the interval mean conceals exposure associated with reduced retained-sample activity.
targets.required_uncertainty: If product identity, high-rate trace, calibration, or custody is unresolved, do not infer pass or confirmed failure; reconcile the missing record or request a product-specific assay.
forbidden_overreaction: treat every isolated high sample as confirmed degradation
apply the group-P revision to all formulations
claim a universal pulse threshold from three observations
required_lineage: E1 source locators OBS-01 through OBS-06
bounded retirement/replacement relation plus preserved continuous-profile scope
targets.claim_ceiling: bounded synthetic revision design; no external cold-chain safety claim

heldout_access: Held-out paths are excluded from all revision-agent read allowlists and are not used to author this target.
